x: Install KGX's Admin Toolbox, find its Q menu tab, learn who counts as an admin, and give players tools.

t: Does it work with ULX, SAM or sAdmin?
x: Yes. With an admin mod that supports CAMI (ULX, SAM, sAdmin and others) the privilege KGX Admin Toolbox decides who is a toolbox admin; its default minimum rank is admin. Without one, admin and superadmin can use it. See Getting Started.

t: Why can my players not use a tool?
x: Tools are admin-only until a superadmin allows them: Q menu > KGX's Admin Toolbox > Settings > Player Access, for all players or one rank. Settings > Tool Visibility can also hide a tool, and Settings > Licenses can hand tools out with a Tool License.

t: Where are the settings and data saved?
x: On the server in garrysmod/data/kgx_admin_toolbox/. Back it up or restore it with Settings > Backup / Restore. A file that cannot be read is moved to _broken/ and the last good copy in _bak/ is used. Favorites and seen NEW tags are kept on each player's own computer.
Settings > Server Settings has Reset everything / wipe map data. It makes a backup first, so a wipe can be undone in Settings > Backup / Restore.

t: Can players see it in their own language?
x: Yes: Settings > Display > Language (English, Español, Deutsch, Français, Русский, Português (Brasil)), or the server's default from Settings > Translations. The console command is kgxat_lang. Admin panels are still English; translating them is planned.

t: How do I install it on a dedicated server?
x: Subscribe on the Steam Workshop and add it to your server's Workshop collection, or extract the kgx_admin_toolbox folder into garrysmod/addons/. Restart the server; players download it automatically.

t: Where are the patch notes in the game?
x: Q menu > KGX's Admin Toolbox > Settings > Patch Notes & README, or the console commands kgxat_patchnotes and kgxat_readme. Every release is also on the Releases page.

t: I found a bug. Where do I report it?
x: Use the bug report form on GitHub: your toolbox version (on the Q menu tab), the gamemode, what happened and how to make it happen again. Console errors help the most. A comment on the Workshop page works too.

t: What is KGX Core and why is it a required item?
x: KGX Core is the shared library the KGX addons run on: the registry, networking, data files, permissions, translations and the UI kit, installed once. An addon that needs it lists it as a required item, so subscribing to the addon subscribes you to Core too. On its own it adds one page to the Q menu (Utilities > KGX > K

t: Can I edit the files or re-upload the addon?
x: No. The toolbox is not open source: subscribing lets you run it unchanged on your game or server. Edits are lost on updates and are not supported; everything is set in the game (Q menu > KGX's Admin Toolbox > Settings). Re-uploads are reported for takedown.
